name: jwt decode
description: Decode a JWT token and output header, payload, and signature as JSON

name: deps scan
description: Inventory all dependencies from manifest files (local only, no network)

name: deps diff
description: Show dependency changes between two git refs (local only, no network)

name: encode
description: Encode or decode base64, base64url, hex or URL text, or hash a file, and check the result

name: cert
description: Decode certificates (PEM or DER, one or a chain) and check the chain order, signatures, validity and an optional host (local only, no network)

name: report
description: Summarise a JUnit, TRX, SARIF, lcov or Cobertura report as one JSON result, checked against its own totals (local only, no network)

name: log
description: Triage a large log into grouped errors and warnings, with counts, line numbers, samples and stack traces

name: secrets scan
description: Find credential-shaped strings in a file, folder, stdin or the staged diff (local only; exit 1 on findings)

name: size
description: Count bytes, lines and estimated tokens for a file or folder, and outline a file (local only)

name: time convert
description: Convert a time between time zones, reporting DST gaps and overlaps

name: time duration
description: Read an ISO 8601 duration, or write a number of seconds as one

name: time business-days add
description: Add or subtract business days, skipping weekends and listed holidays

name: time business-days diff
description: The business time between two times, in business days and hours

name: time cron
description: Explain a cron expression and list its next run times in a zone

name: semver compare
description: Compare two versions and name the part they differ in (local only, no network)

name: semver satisfies
description: Check whether a version satisfies a range (local only, no network)

name: semver sort
description: Sort versions, and find the highest that satisfies a range (local only, no network)

name: semver bump
description: Bump a version: the next major, minor, patch or prerelease (local only, no network)

name: openapi list
description: List the operations in an OpenAPI or Swagger document, filtered by tag or path (local only)

name: openapi show
description: Show one operation: its parameters and where each goes, its request and response bodies, and how to call it with <area> api (local only)

name: openapi example
description: Generate a minimal valid example body for an operation's request or a response, checked against its schema (local only)
